title: Wren and the Interior
author: Bram Coldharbour
blurb: Orsen Halloran, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
